name: DUFU
recent: Dufu 在 2026 年 10 月 27 日公布季度业绩，净利创四年来单季最高。公司持续因 ESOS 行使而发行新股，同时 CFO 与主要子公司董事出现售股申报。
notable: 公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日季度业绩，净利创四年来单季最高。
因 ESOS 行使而多次发行新股并上市。
CFO David Khoo Chong Beng 与主要子公司董事 Wong Ser Yian 申报售股。
risks: CFO 与主要子公司董事在近期申报售股。
ESOS 新股持续发行，股本逐步扩大。
earnings: 2026 年第三季营收 8962 万令吉，环比减 3.0%，同比增 31.3%；净利 1555 万令吉，环比增 11.9%，同比增 456.3%；净利率 17.4%，高于上季的 15.0%。

recent_en: Dufu announced its quarterly results on 27 Oct 2026, with net profit hitting the highest quarterly level in four years. The company continued to issue new shares from ESOS exercises, while its CFO and a director of a major subsidiary reported share disposals.
notable_en: Announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 Sep 2026, with net profit at the highest quarterly level in four years.
Issued and listed new shares multiple times arising from ESOS exercises.
CFO David Khoo Chong Beng and director of a major subsidiary Wong Ser Yian reported share disposals.
risks_en: The CFO and a director of a major subsidiary reported recent share disposals.
New shares continue to be issued under ESOS, gradually enlarging the share base.
earnings_en: 3Q2026 revenue was MYR 89.62 million, down 3.0% QoQ but up 31.3% YoY; net profit was MYR 15.55 million, up 11.9% QoQ and 456.3% YoY; net margin was 17.4%, higher than 15.0% in the previous quarter.
